sentences.en: Compact discs have entirely taken the place of phonograph records.
sentences.zh: 光盘完全取代了黑胶唱片。

sentences.en: This washing machine is compact and good value for money.
sentences.zh: 这台洗衣机既紧凑又物超所值。

sentences.en: I really need an easy to carry dictionary that's compact.
sentences.zh: 我真的需要一本便于携带且精炼的字典。

senses.zh: 小型的，袖珍的；紧凑的；紧密的，坚实的；矮小而健壮的；（演讲，作品）简洁的，简练的
带镜小粉盒；合约，协定；小型汽车；袖珍物；坯块
